Cocktails
MAI TAI
A fabulous South Seas potion that blends the sunny glow of
rum with the exotic flavors of tropical fruit.
Sip! And dream of sunset on the reef.
MENEHUNEJUICE
This lighthearted libation creates the right mood for
Menehune watching. A rainbow of Polynesian flavors
combines with fine light rum to set the stage.

GARDEN ISLE SALAD
A monkeypod bowl contains fresh garden vegetables and fresh pineapple
with a touch of coconut. Garnished and served with Gourmet Dressing.
Your Choice of
BEEF ESTERHAZY
Created for a Prince of the Hungarian House of Esterhazy.
We combine tender
slices of beef, cooked in a sauce rich with red wine and tomatoes with a
touch of Hungarian paprika, and top it all with a fine julienne of vegetables
sauteed in butter. A contribution to our menu by Chef Wolfgang Mayer
of the Kona Surf Hotel on our Big Island of Hawaii.
THE CHEF'S SPECIALTY
BARBECUED CHICKEN MAUNA KEA
Tender breast of chicken prepared with Chinese Oyster Sauce, onions,
shoyu and other special ingredients. Served with rice pilaf and a medley
of garden vegetables.
TORTELLINI FLORENTINE
This is not an everyday dish. We arrange specially filled pasta pillows,
add a tempting cheese sauce, ham and spinach, and top it off with
a sprinkle of Parmesan Cheese.
DINNER ROLL and BUTTER
